baseline_models.focus_anchor: The paired min bayni aydihim/min khalfihim construction, doubled sadd, fa-aghsaynahum, and la yubsirun.
baseline_models.mechanism: A forward interval and a rear interval are each closed by a barrier; an overlying cover then removes visual access. The sequence couples blocked orientation or movement with blocked perception rather than merely placing two unrelated walls.

activation_trace.role: Making as causing a state supplies the imposed configuration that holds the enclosure together.
The interval or space between things locates the first barrier in the subjects' forward field.
What is between the hands means what is before or immediately ahead, fixing the first directional axis.
Filling a gap and blocking passage supplies both repeated closures.
The rear as the opposite of the front establishes the second directional axis.
A cover rising over and concealing something adds a perceptual layer to the spatial closure.
Ocular seeing names the disabled output of the completed enclosure.

changed_reading.before: Two walls happen to stand near people who are blind.
changed_reading.after: An imposed, layered apparatus closes both directions of bodily orientation and then suppresses the seeing needed to navigate them.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: Aydihim can mark what is immediately ahead, while khalf can mark what comes after; both horizons receive the same repeated barrier.
baseline_models.mechanism: The front and rear geometry can also bracket a lived timeline: what is imminent and what succeeds or remains after the subject. Sealing both horizons and covering insight leaves the subject unable to relate present conduct either to what approaches or to what follows.

activation_trace.role: The immediately forward or near field supplies the prospective horizon.
Something that comes after another supplies the consequential or succeeding horizon.
The doubled blockage closes both temporalized horizons.
The concealing cover turns horizon closure into loss of accessible awareness.
Insight of the heart makes non-seeing capable of naming failed recognition, not only failed eyesight.

changed_reading.before: The verse blocks only literal lines of sight.
changed_reading.after: The verse can also seal anticipation and retrospection, leaving the present cut off from both approach and consequence.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The causative jaalna acts on the zone before the hands, while the final construction negates basar.
baseline_models.mechanism: The hands can carry power and attributed action as well as mark direction. A barrier placed before that zone can therefore intercept effective action, while the cover prevents the insight by which action would be corrected.

activation_trace.role: Causative making assigns the subjects a constrained state rather than reporting an accidental setting.
Work or liability attributed to the hands activates the forward field as a zone of agency.
Blocking a road or gap functions as interdiction of effective reach.
The cover conceals the information by which agency could redirect itself.
Inner discernment supplies the disabled corrective capacity.

changed_reading.before: The subjects merely cannot inspect their surroundings.
changed_reading.after: Their effective reach and their capacity to recognize and correct its direction are jointly interdicted.

context_deltas.mechanism: The immediately preceding ayah fixes necks in collars reaching the chins and leaves heads raised; the focus then places barriers on both directional axes and adds a cover. Together they form a staged sensorimotor lock: posture constrains reorientation, barriers close routes, and covering defeats vision.

activation_trace.role: Causing a state links the neck apparatus to the same imposed configuration continued in the focus.
The literal neck supplies the bodily pivot whose movement is constrained.
A collar that binds an organ supplies the fastening element of the posture lock.
The meeting point of the jaws marks how high the collar reaches and narrows head mobility.
Raising the head away from water supplies the forced upward orientation preceding the visual closure.
The paired barriers extend bodily fixation into blocked forward and rearward passage.
The overlying cover completes the apparatus at the perceptual level.
Failure of ocular sight is the apparatus's stated output.

structural_cues: 36:8 immediately precedes the focus and repeats jaalna before the focus repeats the same imposed-making syntax.
The sequence runs neck to collar to chin to raised head, then front barrier to rear barrier to cover to non-seeing.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a fixed posture followed by directional barriers and a cover; I infer that limited head orientation, blocked routes, and occlusion cooperate. A live alternative is that each bodily image independently figures moral constraint rather than one physical apparatus.

changed_reading.before: The barriers are external scenery around otherwise mobile observers.
changed_reading.after: The focus completes a bodily apparatus already begun at the neck, producing coordinated immobility and blindness.

context_deltas.mechanism: The next ayah defines the enclosed state by response invariance: warning and no warning have equal effect. The following contrast identifies reception as tracking the reminder and responding to what is unseen. Thus non-seeing is not absence of a signal but failure of the signal to alter orientation.

activation_trace.role: Equality between two conditions supplies the invariant output of the enclosure.
Warning that should awaken caution supplies the input that now fails to change the subjects.
Heart-settling assent supplies the absent receptive result.
Following trace after trace supplies the responsive motion that contrasts with sealed orientation.
A reminder that makes one remember supplies the guidance being tracked.
Fear joined with awe supplies an inward response rather than detached observation.
What is hidden from eyes proves that effective reception need not depend on direct visual presence.
The cover becomes the condition under which warning cannot penetrate or redirect.
Insight turns the final non-seeing into failed recognition and response.

structural_cues: 36:10 follows the focus with an explicit warning/no-warning equivalence.
36:11 then restricts effective warning to a follower of the reminder who fears in the unseen.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies an invariant non-believing response and a contrasting receptive profile; I infer that the focus apparatus models closed receptivity. The alternative is a contrast between separate populations without a claim about the apparatus's internal operation.

changed_reading.before: Not seeing means that visual evidence is unavailable.
changed_reading.after: Not seeing means that available warning cannot produce a change of orientation, while genuine reception can operate even toward the unseen.

context_deltas.mechanism: The sequence after the focus records what people send ahead and the traces they leave, then exhaustively counts them in a clear register. This activates the front/rear enclosure as a failure to see both projected action and its trailing wake; importantly, their blindness does not erase either from the record.

activation_trace.role: Writing as an establishing record supplies durable accountability outside the subjects' sight.
Advancing something ahead supplies the forward vector of deeds already sent on.
A remaining mark that indicates what occurred supplies the backward wake of action.
Exhaustive counting ensures that neither forward deed nor residual trace escapes the record.
Manifest clarity characterizes the register and opposes the subjects' non-seeing.
Action attributed to hands lets the forward barrier attach to deeds as well as direction.
What follows after something supplies the consequential wake behind the actor.
Loss of insight prevents the actor from integrating deeds with their preserved effects.

structural_cues: 36:12 follows the warning contrast and pairs ma qaddamu with atharahum.
The focus's front/rear pairing is answered by an ahead/trace pairing under exhaustive, manifest recording.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies deeds advanced, effects left behind, and a clear exhaustive record; I map those vectors onto the focus's front and rear. The live alternative is that the focus remains purely spatial and 36:12 introduces an independent accounting image.

changed_reading.before: The barriers merely keep external objects out of view.
changed_reading.after: They also estrange actors from the forward reach and trailing effects of their own conduct, although both remain fully legible in the record.

context_deltas.mechanism: The exact front/behind formula reappears as the field one is told to guard against or attend to in hope of mercy. The focus barriers can therefore be read as closing the very comprehensive horizon toward which precaution should extend.

activation_trace.role: Putting oneself under protection supplies the active posture requested toward the surrounding field.
The same interval construction reopens the focus's forward field as an object of precaution.
What is immediately before the hands exactly repeats the first directional horizon.
What is behind exactly repeats the second directional horizon.
Merciful tenderness supplies the possible outcome of an alert, guarded relation to both horizons.
The barriers close the same paired field that the later imperative asks the hearers to guard.
The cover prevents comprehensive vigilance across that field.

structural_cues: 36:45 repeats ma bayna aydikum wa-ma khalfakum with the same front-then-behind order.
The repeated formula is governed by an imperative of self-protection and followed by a mercy purpose.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies an exact formulaic echo under a protective imperative; I infer that the later use reactivates the focus geometry as an ethical horizon. The alternative is that both are independent uses of a conventional expression for total surroundings.

changed_reading.before: The paired barriers describe only what has been imposed on the subjects.
changed_reading.after: They close a field toward which an alert person is later commanded to adopt comprehensive precaution, exposing enclosure as the inverse of vigilance.

context_deltas.mechanism: Signs repeatedly come to the subjects, yet they turn their sides away. This supplies a behavioral mechanism that can coexist with the imposed cover: non-seeing is maintained by active aversion to what arrives, not by absence of visible material.

activation_trace.role: Coming or arrival supplies evidence that reaches the subjects' vicinity.
A manifest sign supplies the potentially visible and directive content being presented.
Turning one's side away supplies the subjects' own repeated contribution to non-reception.
The cover can now be read as a settled condition reinforced by aversive orientation.
Failure of insight is the result despite repeated arrival of manifest signs.

structural_cues: 36:46 uses an iterative no-sign-except pattern, making aversion habitual rather than singular.
It immediately follows the repeated front/behind warning in 36:45.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies arriving signs and repeated turning away; I infer a feedback loop in which enacted aversion maintains the focus's imposed closure. The alternative keeps divine covering and human turning as parallel descriptions without a causal loop.

changed_reading.before: The subjects fail to see because nothing can reach them.
changed_reading.after: Manifest signs do reach them, but repeated lateral aversion helps make the imposed cover a stable mode of non-reception.

context_deltas.mechanism: The awaited future contracts into one sudden cry that seizes people during dispute; they can neither make a last connecting instruction nor return to their people. The focus's front and rear barriers become a compressed terminal interval with no usable lookahead and no recoverable route back.

activation_trace.role: Waiting for a time supplies the prospective gaze that falsely assumes an interval remains.
A single terrifying cry collapses the expected future into a sudden event.
Seizure or capture removes control of the transition.
Capacity names what is lost when the terminal interval closes.
An entrusted instruction meant to connect onward cannot be transmitted.
The group of belonging supplies the rearward human destination that cannot be regained.
Return to a prior place supplies the explicitly closed backward route.
The field immediately ahead becomes unavailable time for anticipation or preparation.
The rearward field becomes the unavailable route back to prior relations.

structural_cues: 36:49 moves from waiting to one cry to seizure within a single sentence.
36:50 answers that compression with paired negations of final instruction and return.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies expectation, sudden seizure, inability to transmit, and inability to return; I assign these to the focus's forward and rear axes. The alternative treats the pair only as consequences of suddenness, without reactivating the barrier image.

changed_reading.before: The front and rear barriers are stable objects in space.
changed_reading.after: They can model a terminal closure of time: no actionable future remains before the subjects and no return remains behind them.

context_deltas.mechanism: Later, mouths are sealed while hands speak and feet testify to acquisition. This converts the focus's hands from a directional marker into repositories of agency and evidence: the subjects are unable to see their own situation, but their embodied conduct remains able to disclose it.

activation_trace.role: A secured preventing seal disables the mouth as the subject's controlled channel.
The mouth opened for speech supplies the channel that is now closed.
Intelligible speech shifts from the sealed mouth to the hands.
Acts attributed to the hands let them disclose the agency previously hidden from the subjects.
Testimony as informed declaration supplies the body's evidentiary function.
The literal feet preserve the traveled side of embodied conduct.
What was acquired by action supplies the content to which hands and feet testify.
The focus's hand field now carries latent forensic agency as well as frontality.
The subjects' failed self-insight contrasts with the body's successful disclosure.

structural_cues: 36:65 reverses ordinary channels: the mouth is closed, hands speak, and feet witness.
The later hand occurrence is explicitly tied to what the subjects used to acquire.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies channel reversal and embodied testimony; I infer that the focus's hand image can carry unrecognized agency whose evidence survives enclosure. The alternative is a separate forensic scene with no semantic feedback into the earlier spatial idiom.

changed_reading.before: Hands only locate the front barrier.
changed_reading.after: Hands also hold a record of agency: what the enclosed subjects cannot recognize about themselves can later speak through the very organs named in the enclosure.

context_deltas.mechanism: Two adjacent counterfactuals decompose the focus apparatus. One erases eyes and asks how people racing for the path could see; the next transforms them in place so they can neither proceed nor return. In retrospect, the focus combines these otherwise separable failures: visual access and bidirectional locomotion.

activation_trace.role: Loss of light and sight supplies a direct alternative operation for visual disabling.
The literal seeing eyes identify the organ affected in the visual counterfactual.
Racing forward supplies attempted locomotion even when visual guidance is removed.
The straight road supplies a real route whose availability is useless without sight.
The exact seeing root repeats the focus output and ties the counterfactual back to it.
Transforming bodily form supplies a distinct operation for disabling movement.
Place or station fixes the subjects at the location where movement is removed.
Capacity names the lost ability to traverse either direction.
Passing onward supplies the forward motion that becomes impossible.
Returning to a prior state or place supplies the backward motion that also becomes impossible.
The two barriers compact the later forward/return motion failure into one bilateral image.
The cover compacts the later eye-erasure counterfactual into the same apparatus.

structural_cues: 36:66 and 36:67 are adjacent law counterfactuals with the same wa-law nasha opening.
36:66 repeats yubsirun, while 36:67 pairs forward passage with return.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet separately supplies erased sight and immobilized forward/return movement; I infer that the earlier focus fuses those modules. The alternative is a series of independent power demonstrations whose shared vocabulary does not imply decomposition.

changed_reading.before: The cover and barriers redundantly express one vague incapacity.
changed_reading.after: They are complementary modules: the cover disables visual guidance, while the two barriers disable forward and reverse movement.

context_deltas.mechanism: The closing argument asks the human to see, then diagnoses forgetting of his own creation while he denies renewed life to decayed bones; the answer points back to first origination. This supplies a precise temporal enclosure: origin behind is forgotten and re-creation ahead is denied.

activation_trace.role: Reflective seeing by the heart supplies the demanded self-recognition.
Loss of remembered knowledge closes access to the subject's own origin.

The beginning and priority of a thing identify the retrospective horizon that was forgotten.
A counted occurrence supplies the first instance used to warrant another.
The immediately ahead field becomes the denied horizon of renewed life.
What precedes and leaves a successor activates the forgotten originating horizon behind.
Failure of inner recognition unifies forgotten origin and denied renewal as non-seeing.

The argument moves backward to origin in order to reopen the forward possibility of re-creation.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies reflective seeing, forgotten origin, decayed remains, and first origination as the answer; I map origin behind and renewal ahead onto the focus axes. The alternative is a local resurrection argument without intentional reuse of the enclosure's temporal potential.

changed_reading.before: The subjects cannot see what lies spatially around them.
changed_reading.after: Their enclosure is also temporal self-amnesia: they cannot see backward to the act that originated them or forward to its capacity to originate again.

It remains root-anchored and is activated by the later straight-path and reason sequence; downstream prose should present it only as an ironic lexical resonance, never as a replacement translation for sadd.

changed_reading.after: As a contained root resonance, the obstacle may ironically figure right direction turned into its opposite: failed sadad congealed as a sadd.

activation_trace.role: A guarding barrier supplies the form-distant image of an enclosure experienced as protection.

changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, the enclosure can resemble a protective shell whose very insulation prevents the subjects from encountering what could correct them.

strongest_changes: The preceding neck-collar posture turns the focus into a coordinated sensorimotor apparatus rather than two isolated walls.
Warning/no-warning equivalence recasts non-seeing as response invariance despite available signals.
Forward deeds and trailing traces temporalize the two horizons while showing that blindness does not erase accountability.
The exact front/behind formula in 36:45 reopens the enclosed field as one requiring active vigilance.
The paired counterfactuals in 36:66-67 decompose the focus into complementary visual and locomotor failures.
summary.what_was_special: The whole-surah packet repeatedly reuses the focus's hands, front/behind geometry, seeing root, path, proceeding, and returning. Those recurrences preserve several simultaneous readings: bodily immobilization, closed receptivity, temporal horizon loss, unrecognized agency, and forensic exposure.
remaining_uncertainties: The packet does not decide whether imposed covering and repeated human aversion form a causal feedback loop or remain parallel descriptions.
The temporal mapping of front to what approaches and behind to origin or consequence is coherent but does not displace the strong spatial baseline.
The sadad/sadd and protective-iyad activations are intentionally retained as branch-distant resonances and should not be rendered as direct lexical meanings.
